name: @repo/repo-guards
description: Derived fitness tests over the repository itself — the checks that belong to no product package because they read the whole tree: the CLAUDE.md dep-DAG paragraph against the real manifests (which also pins packages/ shipped source free of node/electron), the Bridge registry's freedom from dead channels, the pi harness quarantine, where `ssr` may be declared in apps/web's route tree, every /v1/host URL naming a leaf the host serves, what the agent image's install layer is keyed on, what a delete is allowed to promise across the three surfaces that say it, and every relative markdown link resolving to a file that exists. Ships nothing. See README.md.
